'''2001 random.convention tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG money tournament held in random.convention, Marietta, Georgia on 18 March 2001. [[Charlie Herren]] won it. It is known from Adam Drake's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1929">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-team-atlanta-vs-the-a-s-s-3-18-01d1929/ team-atlanta-vs-the-a-s-s-3-18-01], DeckTech (Adam "ADrake" Drake, 20 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-team-atlanta-vs-the-a-s-s-3-18-01d1929/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 March 2001
* '''Site:''' random.convention, Marietta, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Charlie Herren]]
